title: Monumento Gigante de Cencerro de Bronce en los Alpes Suizos Fotorrealista
prompt: Transform a traditional Swiss cowbell into a massive real-world monument. Surface materials are physically accurate bronze with visible patina, wear, scratches, and dust, with scale references like people and vehicles surrounding it. The enormous bell sits in an Alpine meadow setting. Shot from a low-angle cinematic perspective, realistic daylight with mountain backdrop, ultra-detailed textures showing the craftsmanship and weathering.
